'''2011 Match Play Championship Day 1 Matthew Harrison-Trainor LS You Can Either Profit By This...''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Matthew Harrison-Trainor]] at [[2011 Match Play Championship]] (Day 1).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|You Can Either Profit By This... / Or Be Destroyed|EJP-L-youcaneitherprofitbythis.gif}}
* '''Deck name:''' Profit
* '''Username:''' Blarg
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Virtual Block 7.2]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
